blocks.text: KUALA LUMPUR–Commonwealth Games gold medalist weightlifter Mohd Hafizuddin Roslin had his right arm amputated after a serious motorcycle accident in his native Malaysia. The 21-year-old was conscious and in a stable condition in hospital on Thursday, three days after the crash, the country’s top weightlifting official said. Hafizuddin won Commonwealth gold in the 88kg event in Glasgow in July and was a prospect for the Los Angeles 2028 Olympics. “He is awake and smiling,” Malaysia Weightlifting Federation president Ayub Rahmat told AFP. “Physically his condition is improving but this incident has had a great impact on his future.” He called it […]...
